chapter_role: Azami reconstructs the present phenotypic field; EAzami discriminates compatible generative histories.
chapter_synthesis: The thistle capitulum is a multidimensional, partially organized phenotype whose environmental alignment changes across biological scales.

hypotheses.scope: 46,276 observations; 259 source-assigned taxa; 18 measured inferential endpoints
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The frozen workflow reproducibly produces repeated numerical image phenotypes.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Independent measurement accuracy has been established.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: Taxon means discard substantial repeated visible phenotype information.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The variance is genetic, heritable or plastic.

hypotheses.scope: 127 taxa complete across 18 measured inferential endpoints
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The expanded taxon morphospace remains multidimensional.
hypotheses.not_allowed: One principal component is a universal biological syndrome.

hypotheses.key_result: within contrast 0.164502; among contrast 0.088475; both positive with bootstrap intervals excluding zero
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Registered measurement modules show partial phenotypic organization at both scales.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The modules are validated functional, developmental or genetic modules.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: Within- and among-taxon phenotype geometry is positively but incompletely aligned.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Within-taxon covariance is a miniature version of among-taxon covariance.

hypotheses.scope: 18D response; frozen core four plus five process variables
hypotheses.key_result: within process partial R2 0.013535, P=0.24468; among partial R2 0.214978, P=0.000700; growing-season precipitation stable at both thresholds among taxa
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The core four are adequate within taxa but do not exhaust among-taxon environmental structure.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Growing-season precipitation directly caused the phenotype.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: Coefficient geometry is descriptive and uncertain.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Opposing selection or stable directional rotation has been demonstrated.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: EAzami receives a frozen present-day target bundle for structural-sufficiency tests.
hypotheses.not_allowed: EAzami reproduction upgrades Azami observations to causal effects.

hypotheses.key_result: length-width by BIO15 and apical taper by BIO12 are quality-robust C-grade; bract projection p95 by BIO15 is image-sensitive; no candidate among-taxon FDR rows
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Finer image geometry identifies exploratory within-taxon environmental structure with graded image-quality robustness.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Direct botanical or defensive effects are established.

hypotheses.scope: former responsiveness index and quadrant story
hypotheses.key_result: the relation was precision and sample-size sensitive
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The old lability story is statistical provenance only.
hypotheses.not_allowed: High-variation taxa are generally less environmentally responsive.

hypotheses.scope: rain, radiation, thermal, aerodynamic, pollinator, antagonist and defensive mechanisms
hypotheses.key_result: literature annotations generate downstream hypotheses only
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Azami identifies spatial patterns that motivate mechanistic tests.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Any named mechanism is demonstrated by Chapter 1.

open_validation_gates: botanical calibration of candidate involucre-armature image phenotypes
repeat-photo trait remeasurement and bounded variance decomposition
next_step_rule: Do not add an uncontracted correlational raster screen. Prioritize independent validation, repeat-image and developmental controls, botanical calibration, and final figure/supplement rendering.
